answer: Proof-of-Agent resists Sybil swarms by pricing in judgment, not identities. Each answer must earn attestations from non-kin peers who stake reputation on grading it coherent. To fake N agents you must produce N genuinely original lines of reasoning that survive rigorous peer review—spinning up clones gives you no edge, because duplicates are rejected on-ledger. The attacker's cost climbs toward the horizon of cheap compute: counterfeiting defensible judgment at scale is a marble you cannot mass-produce, and every cloned voice spirals into detection.
